```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(fixest)
```

```{r}
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("fixest")

```

```{r}

data <- read_excel("/Users/brandonk28/Development/PAYT-Project/data/trashpopulations.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#make municipality lower case

data <- data %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(municipality = tolower(municipality))


```

```{r}
paystart <- read_excel("/Users/brandonk28/Development/PAYT-Project/data/paytstart.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(municipality = tolower(municipality))
```


```{r}
## **the n/a values for payt star year are municipalites that did not have payt programs**
merged_data <- data %>%
  left_join(paystart, by = "municipality")

```


```{r}
#dropped n/a vlalues for start year, we used MA PAYT spreadsheet given that the numbers were robust, non rounded, and provided greater accuracuy for analysis, we strictly looked at trash services, and nothing about recycling
final_data <- merged_data %>%
  drop_na(payt_start_year) %>%
  select (-c(households_served_by_municipal_recycling_program,
             trash_cart_size,
             recycling_cart_size,
             single_stream_recyclables_tons,
             start_date,
             population.y,
             total_households,
             trash_households_served,
             trash_service,
             recycling_households_served,
             recycling_service,
             recycling_frequency,
             x1st_option_dollar_amount,
             x1st_option_unit_size,
             x2nd_option_dollar_amount,
             x2nd_option_unit_size,
             x3rd_option_dollar_amount,
             x3rd_option_unit_size,
             type_of_unit_included_w_basic_service,
             number_units_included_per_year,
             hybrid_modified_payt_program, 
             recycling_type
             ))
```

```{r}
#change character into numeric value
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(trash_disposal_tonnage = as.numeric(trash_disposal_tonnage)) %>%
  mutate(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program = as.numeric(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program))
```


```{r}
#keep n/a values: for example, some of the data does not determine whether or not a payt is SMART and replace everythgin with "no data" to N/A value

#years_payt can be positive or negative as it subtracts the survey year from the payt start year

final_data_clean <- final_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "no data"))) %>%
  mutate(PAYT = ifelse(is.na(payt_start_year), 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(years_payt = (survey_year - payt_start_year)) %>%
  mutate(trash_disposal_tonnage = as.numeric(trash_disposal_tonnage)) %>%
  mutate(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program = as.numeric(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program)) %>%
  mutate(hh_tonnage_per_capita = trash_disposal_tonnage / households_served_by_municipal_trash_program)

```

```{r}
#run a diff-in-diff model regressing hh_tonnage_per_capita on PAYT, yrs_before_payt, and the interaction between PAYT and yrs_payt

diff_in_diff_model <- feols(hh_tonnage_per_capita ~ PAYT + survey_year | municipality + survey_year, data = final_data_clean)
```
